title: Tourism 4.0, Enit promotes EU ECO TANDEM
subtitle: Enit promotes the EU Eco-Tandem program co-financed by the European Union through the COSME program in support of SMEs, to promote the development of sustainable tourism through transnational cooperation and the networking of the know-how of entrepreneurs operating in the travel sector.
author: La Redazione
body:
Enit promotes the EU Eco-Tandem program co-financed by the European Union through the COSME program in support of SMEs, to promote the development of sustainable tourism through transnational cooperation and the networking of the know-how of entrepreneurs operating in the travel sector.
